sentence: This project studies how robots can recognize signs of emotional distress and respond with speech, gestures, and gentle touch.
This project develops methods for combining information from multiple datasets to make findings more reliable.
This project develops synthetic routes to nanocarbon compounds that have optical and electronic properties like those of graphene.
This project tries to find out what triggers melanin production in a fungus that lives with algae and a cyanobacterium.
This project develops technologies that make feature engineering automated, robust, and adaptive for machine learning models.
This project designs smaller vector representations so advanced artificial intelligence can run on tiny, low-power devices.
This project studies how the nervous system changes during development and in response to stimuli.
This project acquires a super-resolution spinning disc confocal microscope to answer biological questions with live imaging.
This project designs safe algorithms that let robots learn tasks from demonstrations by people, to assist elderly individuals at home.
This project develops legged robots whose legs are driven by a small number of powerful motors to walk fast over rough terrain.
This project studies why some bird species are frequently infected with blood parasites while others largely escape them.
This project creates advanced artificial intelligence that runs on devices used in everyday applications.
This project builds a software system that lets computers analyze sensitive health information while it stays locked and hidden.
This project tries to find out how micelles made from block copolymers form and change toward a more favorable state.
This project applies federated learning and differential privacy to diagnose skin diseases from sensitive medical images.
This project examines whether wild turkeys, pheasants, partridges, and quails spread highly pathogenic avian influenza to poultry.
This project develops a testbed that uses sensors and machine learning to improve the power output of solar arrays.
